endp.mgov66zy.24l8.short_descr: Add a new user to the system
endp.mgov66zy.24l8.description:
Add or updates a user to the system.
If the `id` is specified, the user is updated. 
If the `id` field is missing, the user is created as new.

A few checks are made:

For new users:

- if `username` + `domain` are already in the system, then the new user is rejected
- if `email` + `domain` are already in the system, then the new user is rejected

For existing users:

- if `username` + `domain` are already in the system and the `id` is different from current user, then the new user is rejected
- if `email` + `domain` are already in the system and the `id` is different from current user, then the new user is rejected

parameters.name: email_verified
parameters.description: Flag T/F to set email already verified

endp.msaa2mvd.aex4.short_descr: Add or update a user role
endp.msaa2mvd.aex4.description: Add or updates a user role. If the id is specified, the role is updated (fields omitted in the request keep their current stored value - PATCH semantics, not full replace). If id is missing, a new role is created in the caller's domain. Rejects a duplicate name within the same domain. On update, any permission newly added to the role is unioned (additively) into perms of every user currently assigned to that role via id_role; permissions removed from the role are never retroactively removed from already-assigned users.

endp.msaa4ynk.iu9b.description: Deletes a user role by id. Users currently assigned to the role are unlinked (id_role set to null); their existing perms are left untouched. Returns 404 if the role does not exist.

endp.msaa67ik.evaq.short_descr: List all roles for the current domain
endp.msaa67ik.evaq.description: Lists all roles defined for the current user's domain, with the same pagination behavior as user_list (offset/limit). Domain filter is bypassed only for a system.admin user in the system domain.

endp.msaa8ckz.aua9.short_descr: Assign a role to a user
endp.msaa8ckz.aua9.description: Assigns a role to a user. Sets users.id_role and unions (additively) the role's perms into the user's existing perms - no permission already on the user is removed. Returns 404 if the user or role does not exist, 400 if the role belongs to a different domain than the target user.

parameters.name: id_user
parameters.description: ID user to assign role to

endp.msec0vfy.aa01.short_descr: Verify a user email address with a token
endp.msec0vfy.aa01.description: Validates an email verification token and marks the user's email as verified. Tokens expire after 7 days and can only be used once (used_at is set on success and re-checked on every call). The token is sent in the request body, never as a query parameter, so it does not leak into proxy/CDN access logs or browser history.

endp.msec0rsn.aa02.description: Sends a new email verification link to the user. Expires/deletes any previous email_verify tokens for the user and generates a fresh token valid for 7 days. Unauthenticated endpoint that triggers an outbound email, so it is rate limited per IP (RL_AUTH).

endp.mt3pw0ex.set1.short_descr: Force or clear the password change
endp.mt3pw0ex.set1.description: Sets or clears the password_expired flag of a user. When set, the user must choose a new password at the next login, before a session is created. Same permission and multi-tenant rules as /user/set/password.

parameters.name: password_expired
parameters.description: True to force the password change, false to clear the flag

endp.mt3pw0ch.chg1.description: Completes a login blocked by an expired password. Takes the pending_token returned by /user/login (or /user/2fa/verify) and the new password, stores it, clears the expired flag and returns the full login. Unauthenticated, so it is rate limited per IP (RL_AUTH).

parameters.name: pending_token
parameters.description: Brief JWT returned by the login when requires_password_change is true

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The new password (min 8 characters, different from the current one)

endp.mt4pw0ma.set1.short_descr: Set the password max age of a user
endp.mt4pw0ma.set1.description: Sets the number of days after which the user must change the password. 0 means the password never expires for this user, a missing `days` clears the value so the global cfg.user.passwordMaxAgeDays applies. Same permission and multi-tenant rules as /user/set/password.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days after which the password expires. 0: never. Missing: use the global default

endp.lc16r001.reg1.description: Public sign up. Rejected with 403 unless the config `user.allowRegistration` is true; when `user.registrationAuthCode` is not empty, `auth_code` must match it (403 otherwise). With `user.createDomain` true the user creates a new domain with the same code as the (lowercased) username, rejected with 400 if the username is not a valid domain code or the domain already exists, and becomes its owner with every user.* permission; with it false the user joins the system domain with no permission. The user is created with email_verified=false and a verification email is sent. Returns the created User (no password). Unauthenticated and sending an email, so it is rate limited per IP (RL_AUTH).

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address (also the unique key in the domain)

parameters.name: auth_code
parameters.description: Registration auth code. Required when `user.registrationAuthCode` is set

endp.lc16r002.cfg1.short_descr: Registration settings for the sign up form
endp.lc16r002.cfg1.description: Public. Tells the sign up form whether registration is open, whether it creates a domain and whether an auth code is asked. The auth code itself is never returned.

typ.mgouyot5.dccg.name: UserRefresh
typ.mgouyot5.dccg.description: Refresh tokens, stored as a sha256 hex digest with a rotation family
typ.mgouyot5.dccg.doc:
On login an access JWT and a long-lived refresh token are issued.
Only the sha256 hex digest of the refresh token is persisted.
`family_id` ties together every token in the rotation chain born from one login,
so a detected reuse can invalidate the whole chain. `used_at` marks a consumed token.

fields.name: token_hash
fields.description: sha256 hex digest of the refresh token

fields.name: family_id
fields.description: Rotation family: the chain of successors born from a single login

fields.name: used_at
fields.description: Consumption timestamp, unix ms; non-null means already used

fields.name: name
fields.description: Role name, unique per domain (required, max 64 chars)

evt.i4jmmen1.rjyp.description: Self-service registration call. Payload: username, email, password, domain, name, lastname. Rejects if `domain` already exists in the system. On success creates the user in the new domain with email_verified=false, grants it every user.* permission (it becomes the owner/admin of its own domain), sends an email verification link (same token flow as /user/email/resend, valid 7 days), and returns the created User.

evt.lc15a001.upd1.description: Change name, lastname and/or email of a user. Payload: id, domain, name?, lastname?, email?. Trusted server code only: the user must belong to `domain` (403 otherwise) and the email must be free in the domain (409). A username equal to the old email follows the new email.
